floater.name: local_mesh
floater.title: LOCAL MESH
floater.floater.string: Select one standalone, editable prim you own. Attachments, linksets and uploaded meshes are not supported yet.
Choose a static FBX, DAE, glTF or GLB model to preview on this prim.
Preview active. Use the normal Move, Rotate and Scale tools. Reload after exporting changes.
Auto Reload is watching this model file, even while this window is closed.
Export changed. Waiting for the file to settle before reloading. Previous preview retained.
Source file is missing, empty or unavailable. Previous preview retained; Auto Reload will resume when the file returns.
Auto Reload could not load this export. Previous preview retained. Export again or click Reload to retry.
Could not load this model. Use a static mesh without rigging. Check its external files and the viewer log. Any previous preview is unchanged.
This graphics configuration cannot render glTF mesh previews.
Local preview removed. The original prim is visible again.
Enable overrides to edit roughness/metallic. Uncheck to use the material's values. Reload preserves overrides; Reset restores the exported material.
Loading PBR material. The previous appearance stays visible until it is ready.
Could not load the PBR material. Previous appearance retained. Choose another material or Reset to Export.
floater.text: Preview a mesh in-world before uploading. Only you see the replacement; others still see the prim.

check_box.name: auto_reload
check_box.label: Auto Reload
check_box.tool_tip: Watch this preview's model file for new exports, even with this window closed. Keeps placement and material overrides.

texture_picker.name: material
texture_picker.label: PBR Material
texture_picker.tool_tip: Choose an inventory or local PBR material for this preview.

check_box.name: override_factors
check_box.label: Override roughness / metallic
check_box.tool_tip: Off uses the assigned or exported material's factors. Turning this off clears your numeric overrides.

floater.text: Initially centered and fitted to the prim, keeping proportions on a cube. Reload preserves that origin and scale.
Session only. Physics and land impact remain the prim's. Supports .fbx / .dae / .glb / .gltf; no rigging.
